name: post-c69b2752 persistent contract grammar v1
question: Which, if any, of three fully frozen persistent strategy contracts is source-reachable, non-breaking, materially distinct from every immutable closure and supported by an observable policy/capacity estimand strongly enough to justify one separate identity protocol?

competingHypotheses.H1: At least one frozen contract passes source, compatibility, alias, evidence, policy-exposure and pre-row capacity-estimand gates; freeze the minimum-ranked survivor only.
competingHypotheses.H0: Every frozen contract aliases a closed family, lacks a complete non-breaking source path, or lacks evidence-backed decision value/policy exposure; close this finite grammar with zero rows.
competingHypotheses.HI: The immutable inputs or reports cannot decide every gate at the frozen cap; record inconclusive and select nothing.

sharedContract.carrier: One additive uncommon relic ID in the existing relic catalogue and ordinary pool. Ownership is the only acquisition identity; no existing ID changes.
sharedContract.aspectBoundary: The effect is active only for Duskblade (run.aspect == 0). Ashwarden ownership is an exact inert negative control.
sharedContract.acquisition: Fixed ownership is evaluated before the existing natural uncommon relic routes. Natural acquisition and payoff are separate factors.
sharedContract.presentation: Reuse the generic relic art, HUD collection, tooltip and RELIC_PROC paths. No new choice screen or control is part of this grammar.
sharedContract.rng: Every effect and null path is deterministic and adds no gameplay RNG call.
sharedContract.policy: Ordinary policy exposure must be stated in the candidate. No trained policy, optimiser or adaptive score is permitted.
sharedContract.identity: Omitted and explicit-off must reproduce exact current-main path, RNG, policy, result and reliability. Enabled may move only the frozen mediator before any endpoint claim.
sharedContract.promotion: The additive research ID is not a product ID. At most one survivor may proceed to a separate identity protocol; none is shipping scope here.

mirror-reliquary-ownership-gate.playerFacingText: As the Duskblade, gaining Ward creates one Afterimage. Warden's Edge consumes one Afterimage to reflect twice your current Ward as damage.
mirror-reliquary-ownership-gate.producer: With the relic owned in Duskblade combat, each positive player Ward gain applies exactly one non-stacking Afterimage after the canonical Ward amount is known.
mirror-reliquary-ownership-gate.mediator: One fight-local player Afterimage marker, absent at combat start and discarded at combat end.
mirror-reliquary-ownership-gate.consumer: Warden's Edge with Afterimage consumes it after its authored damage and Ward effects resolve.
mirror-reliquary-ownership-gate.payoff: Deal non-Attack damage equal to exactly two times current player Ward after Warden's Edge resolves; no Facet chip, status or RNG side effect.
mirror-reliquary-ownership-gate.expiry: Consume once on Warden's Edge or discard at combat end.
mirror-reliquary-ownership-gate.naturalCost: Opportunity cost of choosing one ordinary uncommon relic.
mirror-reliquary-ownership-gate.ordinaryPolicyExposure: Only while the relic is owned, Warden's Edge is held and Afterimage is absent, the existing deterministic policy may value a legal Ward producer with the previously defined minimum non-zero setup cue; no other score changes.
mirror-reliquary-ownership-gate.saveAndUi: Existing relic-ID save array and generic relic presentation only; no mutable run field.
mirror-reliquary-ownership-gate.knownAliasRisk: The exact apply-consume payoff and setup cue were previously evaluated without an ownership gate; ownership must create a materially new decision contract rather than relabel that closed family.

emberglass-memory-one-carry.playerFacingText: As the Duskblade, preserve up to 1 unspent Ember after victory for the next combat.
emberglass-memory-one-carry.producer: After all canonical Duskblade victory and post-combat relic consumers have read the terminal Ember reserve, store min(terminal Embers, 1) when the relic is owned; loss and zero reserve store zero.
emberglass-memory-one-carry.mediator: One namespaced integer at run.quest_scratch['relic.emberglassMemory'], legal values 0 or 1, using the existing durable v2 dictionary and defaulting missing or invalid values to 0.
emberglass-memory-one-carry.consumer: At the end of canonical start-relic application in the next Duskblade combat, add the stored unit after any Ember-cap change, emit the existing Ember and RELIC_PROC events, then clear the stored unit.
emberglass-memory-one-carry.payoff: Exactly one additional starting Ember when charged, capped by the canonical current Ember cap; no direct damage, Ward, draw, Energy, Facet, status or RNG change.
emberglass-memory-one-carry.expiry: Consume at the next combat start; otherwise persist across save/resume until consumed or run end.
emberglass-memory-one-carry.naturalCost: Opportunity cost of choosing one ordinary uncommon relic plus foregoing terminal Art value needed to leave a residual unit.
emberglass-memory-one-carry.ordinaryPolicyExposure: Current deterministic play remains unchanged for the first fixed-ownership screen. Policy sensitivity is the natural variation in Dusk Ember production/spend and terminal residual; a new reserve policy is not authorised unless this gate later measures decision value.
emberglass-memory-one-carry.saveAndUi: No save-schema or new field: reuse questScratch's existing additive dictionary envelope and generic relic presentation. The existing RELIC_PROC event identifies charge and consume; no new control surface.
emberglass-memory-one-carry.knownAliasRisk: Current Crown and Ember families read or add within-combat Embers, but no authorised family may already connect terminal reserve in one combat to the next combat through run persistence.

shard-compass-reward-feedback.playerFacingText: After a Duskblade victory with a Shatter, card rewards offer one additional Facet card.
shard-compass-reward-feedback.producer: A real SHATTER event in the just-won Duskblade combat while the relic is owned.
shard-compass-reward-feedback.mediator: One additional post-combat card-reward slot, present only for that reward and never saved separately.
shard-compass-reward-feedback.consumer: After the canonical reward list is complete, append the first current-pool, non-starter card in canonical pool order that is not already offered and has positive authored chip or a positive chip effect.
shard-compass-reward-feedback.payoff: The unchanged player or deterministic policy may select the extra Facet card; no card value, rarity, existing offer, shared RNG cursor or combat rule changes.
shard-compass-reward-feedback.expiry: The extra slot expires with the current reward screen.
shard-compass-reward-feedback.naturalCost: Opportunity cost of choosing one ordinary uncommon relic and first producing a real Shatter.
shard-compass-reward-feedback.ordinaryPolicyExposure: The existing card choice/decline rule evaluates the added card with its unchanged current score.
shard-compass-reward-feedback.saveAndUi: Pass the completed CombatState read-only to reward generation and reuse the existing reward row; no new saved field or choice screen.
shard-compass-reward-feedback.knownAliasRisk: Prior evidence found acquisition was not the immediate Afterimage bottleneck and closed native acquisition aliases; this new contract needs independent measured decision value rather than a new route label.

backgroundAudit.question: For each exact candidate, does current main provide a complete, deterministic and non-breaking carrier-to-consumer implementation path using only the frozen save/ID/UI consequences?
For each exact candidate, is the full causal contract materially distinct from every immutable closure without reopening a payoff, acquisition, ordering, Ember, Crown or package-commitment family?
For each exact candidate, is the direction evidence-backed, product-semantic-complete and testable through an ordinary policy plus a zero/new-row capacity estimand before any identity implementation?

decisionRules.success: If all three reports are COMPLETE and one or more candidates pass every gate, freeze exactly the minimum-ranked candidate for a separate source/capacity/identity preregistration. Do not implement or run enabled rows here.
decisionRules.futility: If all reports are COMPLETE and no candidate passes every gate, close this exact three-contract grammar with zero rows. Do not add a fourth contract after seeing reports.
decisionRules.inconclusive: Any missing report, input mismatch, incomplete candidate set or non-COMPLETE verdict records inconclusive at cap and selects nothing.
decisionRules.tieBreak: Ascending frozen integer rank, then candidate ID. Outcome magnitude and model preference never break a tie.

claimBoundary: This zero-row gate can freeze at most one exact persistent contract for a separate preregistration, close the exact grammar or record inconclusive. It cannot establish capacity, identity, causality, package admission, detector admission, product scope, protected-seed authority, #421 acceptance or the #108 P9 receipt.
